'''Doma''' was the first [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Dina/Legends|Dina]] in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]],<ref name="EA" /> located in the [[Raioballo sector/Legends|Raioballo sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Doma was a [[Temperature/Legends|scorched]] rock without any [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]], except [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], were first introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EA" />
